Thank you SnotGoblin Terrain For the awesome set to play on today.  All the terrain is from them.  Fully customizable and prepainted ready to go.  It's like lego but for 40k.  They call it future proof for a reason. And It packs up nice and small!

===============SERIES INFO=============

Six players will play over the next 5 months to crown one winner!  We keep track of wins and losses which populate an ever changing leaderboard leading to a single elimination tournament at the end. Lets see which player comes out on top!
